articles.title: 'Grand Theft Auto VI' sets record with $3.79B in first-day retail sales, Rockstar Games reports - KSL News
articles.summary: 'Grand Theft Auto VI' sets record with $3.79B in first-day retail sales, Rockstar Games reports - KSL News. Rockstar Games announces that "Grand Theft Auto VI" has generated a record $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales. The game launched Thursday, marking the first new installment in the series in 13 years.
